CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, November 20, 2024 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Laura Longoria, Commission Member
  Danielle Massaro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF THE SEPTEMBER 18, 2024 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

 IV.  ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS

  V.  STAFF REPORT

 VI.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

VIII.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until adopted by the  November 20, 2024
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, September 18, 2024
  7:00 P.M.
The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:03 P.M. on Wednesday, September 18, 2024, at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street
Alhambra, Conference Room “A”.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present: President Canseco, Vice President Saunders, Commission
Member Hermano, Commission Member Longoria and Commission Member Massaro.
Commission Members Absent: None.
Also attending: Deputy Director Brie Houghton, Recreation Supervisor Amanda Leonard and
Clerical Assistant II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF THE JUNE 19, 2024 REGULAR C.A.C.E. MEETING
With a motion from Vice President Saunders and a second from Commission Member Longoria
the June 19, 2024 minutes were approved.

ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS
Commission Member Longoria and the Alhambra Historical Society board will collaborate and
use historical Alhambra images and postcards for utility box wrap art throughout Alhambra.

All other City Arts and Cultural Events Commission members declined to provide an update on
their Alhambra District Art project.

STAFF REPORT
Recreation Supervisor Amanda Leonard shared that Fiesta Alhambra was a successful event with
large attendance of all ages and invited the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission to attend
the upcoming Safety Fair, Autumn Fest, and Pumpkin Run events with their families.

Director Macias updated the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission with the 2025 Alhambra
Tournament of Roses Parade float campaign timeline and design rendering.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
Haley Hua, representing Mark Keppel High School Tri -M (Music Honor Society), shared a
proposed utility box art rendering to the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission and they
advised with recommendations and the public art project approval process.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
 Commission Member Longoria asked if a Dia de Los Muertos community ofrenda (altar) could
be set up at Alhambra City Hall and Vice President Saunders suggested organizing it as an
installation at the Alhambra Historical Museum.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by President Canseco and a second by Vice President Saunders, the September 18,
2024 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:27 P.M.
